verdict.rationale: The core product is an MIT-licensed set of skill files that the installer writes into your own repo as ordinary, editable files you own. Nothing updates behind your back, and the skills work with any agent and model, so no vendor-hosted service is required to run it. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of running fully offline or from a private mirror (the documented installs pull from GitHub, npx, or plugin marketplaces), and independent hands-on confirmation of self-managed use.
